answer: Graduated trust resists Sybil attacks: a new identity starts with a tiny transaction cap that rises only with months of clean, continuous history. An honest agent simply waits, growing from a yarrow shoot into a full plant, while a fake swarm is stuck at the starting line - thousands of newborns with no history and no weight. Like ivory keys or marble columns, reputation cannot be mass-produced overnight; time is the one resource a Sybil operator cannot clone, so forgery buys volume but never influence.
